selections.title: Paint Color
selections.description: Please visit https://www.sherwin-williams.com/ to select the color you would like to use throughout the home.

selections.title: Quantity of Colors
selections.description:
The number of different colors used for the interior painting of the home. Most common during new construction are, one color where trim (if using paint grade trim), interior doors (if installing paint grade doors), walls and ceilings are all the same color throughout the home, two-color where walls and ceilings are one color and paint grade doors, trim and any other architectural woodwork are a second color, and three-color where walls are one color, ceilings are another color, and interior paint grade trim, doors and architectural woodwork are a third color.

During Pre-Construction Planning, the only item we ask to be selected is the quantity of colors as this impacts pricing. Colors themselves may be selected up to two weeks before completion of the interior painting.

Further customization is available, but it continues to increase in cost for painting the more colors that are added.
